source_row.stem: A mechanically ventilated client is receiving oral care as part of VAP prevention, and a family member assumes this kind of care probably only needs to happen once a day like typical tooth brushing at home. The client should instead receive oral care, including tooth brushing, at what general frequency, per VAP prevention bundles?
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"About once per week, a frequency considered too infrequent under current VAP prevention bundle recommendations for a client like this","B":"A single time during the entire ICU stay, rather than as an ongoing, repeated part of daily care this client actually needs","C":"Skipped in ventilated clients, despite oral care being a core element of VAP prevention bundles for exactly this population","D":"Regularly, typically every 2-4 hours for basic care with brushing at least twice daily, per bundle protocols"}}
source_row.rationale: VAP prevention bundles typically recommend regular oral care for ventilated clients, including basic care every 2-4 hours and tooth brushing at least twice daily, to reduce oral bacterial colonization.
source_row.source_detail: Oral Care Frequency for Ventilated Patients
